plan.name: G-short-trace-registration
plan.inventory: 60 trace conditions only; captures not acquired
plan.f_definition: full 11s received-source late share; full-source 15s median baseline; strict excess >20ms
plan.caveat: Episode counts retain the capped planning formula. Each episode is judged independently from measured main timing pairs and full-identity integrity checks. Late-subset sample estimates are diagnostic only; no episode aggregation is needed.
plan.pair_calibration: C=10G/R=4.5G per line; 9G aggregate, applying the G-short 9G no-Q offer

acceptance.order_population: all packet identities, including unsampled packets
acceptance.storage_population: all packet identities and conservation counters
acceptance.late_subset_insufficient_action: report diagnostic insufficient; do not gate acceptance
